note: build with LAZYOS_DESKTOP=1 LAZYOS_XUI_AUTOSTART=term LAZYOS_AUTOLOGIN=user LAZYOS_UI_PROBE=1 LAZYOS_RESET_OS=1; docs/accounts-plan.md 3.3: elevd shows a package (not a path) on the trusted prompt and installs the bytes it showed
a user package through elevd: the prompt names Counter Demo, its version, system name, author and permissions
not a core app: refused before any prompt
a core app's package as pkg.install: refused before any prompt
the core Counter as pkg.update-core: the prompt names the core app and both versions; cancelled

until: ELEVD:REQUEST op=pkg.update-core .*outcome=cancelled summary="Replace the core app

note: the cancel above holds this caller for 5 s (elevd, review of #659 H4)

type: rhai -e 'msg::set_timeout(0);let p="sys/ui/";for i in 0..20{p+="abcdefgh/"};let v="start";for i in 0..30{v+=" word"};v+="     end";sys::elevd::request("conf.set",[p+"demo","str",v])'
note: a long path and a long text value: the path loses its middle, the value keeps its head and tail and names its length, a run of spaces is counted

until: ELEVD:REQUEST op=conf.set .*outcome=cancelled summary="Set the setting sys/.../
